title: Financial Mathematics: Savings and Profit
introduction: Build on earlier mathematics by studying financial mathematics: savings and profit.
definition: Savings are income minus spending. Profit occurs when selling price exceeds cost price; loss occurs when cost exceeds selling price. Profit and loss percentages are usually calculated relative to cost price.

examples.question: Buy an item for RM80 and sell for RM100.
Save RM35 each week for 12 weeks.

exercises.question: Cost RM60, selling price RM75. Profit RM?
Cost RM100, selling price RM85. Loss RM?
Cost RM50, profit RM10. Profit percent (number only)?
Income RM250, spending RM175. Savings RM?
Save RM25 per week for 16 weeks. Total RM?
Cost RM120, loss 10%. Selling price RM?

summary: Savings are income minus spending. Profit occurs when selling price exceeds cost price; loss occurs when cost exceeds selling price. Profit and loss percentages are usually calculated relative to cost price.
